questions.q: What does Danijela consider the main point about anxiety?
o: It is a serious heart disease
questions.e: In the video: "anksioznost nije bolest" — anxiety is not an illness.

questions.q: Why does she make short YouTube videos?
o: To say more than in an Instagram post
She was forbidden to write texts
questions.e: In the video: "na taj način mogu puno više da kažem nego da napišem u onu Instagram formu" — this way I can say much more than I could write in that Instagram format.

questions.q: According to her experience, what sometimes helps more than a pill?
o: A trip to a shopping mall
questions.e: In the video: "jedan video na temu edukacije, šta je to anksioznost, zna mnogo da pomogne, više nego bilo kakva tableta" — one video on what anxiety is can help more than any pill.

questions.q: How long, she says, does a visit to a psychiatrist last?
questions.e: In the video: "zadržavanje kod psihijatra traje pet ili deset minuta" — a visit to a psychiatrist lasts five or ten minutes.

questions.q: How does anxiety differ from real fear?
o: It is invented in our heads
It is always more dangerous to life
It is caused by a heart disease
It causes no sensations in the body
questions.e: In the video: "anksioznost je neurotski strah, dakle, izmišljen u našoj glavi" — anxiety is neurotic fear, that is, invented in our heads.

questions.q: What happens if you run away from anxiety?
o: It turns into a heart disease
questions.e: In the video: "svaki put kad pobjegnete od anksioznosti, ona se učvrsti" — every time you run away from anxiety, it gets entrenched.

questions.q: In how many sessions, she says, can panic attacks be dealt with?
questions.e: In the video: "mi možemo napad panike, ali i anksioznost završiti u dvije seanse, u tri seanse" — we can finish a panic attack and anxiety in two or three sessions.

questions.q: What are the two things to remember?
o: It is not an illness and nobody came to harm from it
You need to take pills every day
You need to stay at home
questions.e: In the video: "anksioznost nije bolest, to je jedno stanje u koje uđemo svojim načinom razmišljanja" — anxiety is not an illness, it is a state we enter through our way of thinking.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Dobio je neku terapiju, dobio je nešto za *smirenje*
questions.e: smirenje — calming down.

questions.q: Meni vrlo često dolaze sa ogromnim *fasciklama* pregleda
questions.e: fascikla — folder.

questions.q: Ali anksioznost je neurotski strah, dakle, *izmišljen* u našoj glavi
questions.e: izmišljen — made up.

questions.q: jedna dobra *edukativna* forma
questions.e: edukativan — educational.

questions.q: ono što je važno jeste da znate da anksioznost nije *bolest*
questions.e: bolest — illness.

questions.q: mi smo već na *dvojci*
questions.e: dvojka — a two.

questions.q: Strah je *evolucijska* emocija
questions.e: evolucijski — evolutionary.

questions.q: ona se učvrsti, *betonira*, postaje još jača
questions.e: betonirati — to concrete, set firm.

questions.q: Hej, dobar ___, dragi ljudi.
questions.e: Dobar dan — nominative in the greeting.

questions.q: Evo mene danas ___ novim videom
questions.e: Sa + instr.: sa novim videom — with a new video.

questions.q: Zašto ___ temu anksioznosti?
questions.e: Na temu + gen.: on the topic of anxiety.

questions.q: Znači, anksioznost, ljudi moji, nije ___
questions.e: Nije + nom. predicate: nije bolest.

questions.q: kada smo u realnoj životnoj ___
questions.e: U + loc.: u opasnosti — in danger.

questions.q: da ako sam uspjela da ___ jednog čovjeka
questions.e: A single result takes the perfective: pokrenem.

questions.q: svaki put kad ___ od anksioznosti, ona se učvrsti
questions.e: After kad a single completed action takes the perfective: pobjegnete.

questions.q: vi niste ___ psihijatrijski slučajevi
questions.e: Agrees with slučajevi (masc. pl. nom.): nikakvi.
